observations: Fiscal year ends 30 June (FY20 = Jul 2019-Jun 2020); year field = FY end.

Water stress (footnote D129): Lihir classified "extremely high" (interannual variability, sanitation/drinking-water access), Telfer "high", Gosowong "high" per WRI Aqueduct; Cadia is not flagged. NOTE: the app's existing lib/data/newcrest-fy20.json has Lihir "low", Cadia "high", Gosowong "low" (all stressSource "assumed") - this contradicts the source file and should be corrected.

Seawater dominates: Lihir 222,149 ML Category 3 seawater (63% of company withdrawal of 354,742 ML); it is not used in ore processing. Lihir seawater was misclassified as Category 2 before 2019, so FY18 "high quality" withdrawal (322,121 ML, Category 3 "-") is inflated and not comparable. FY19 total 361,730 ML (Cat 1+2: 144,017; Cat 3: 217,713).

Gosowong (divested 4 Mar 2020) is included in FY20 withdrawal (7,858 ML) but excluded from reuse, discharge, storage and consumption ("unable to be verified"). Company consumption 307,537 = Lihir 276,322 + Telfer 18,159 + Cadia 13,056.

Telfer consumption (18,159) equals its withdrawal (18,159) even though 3,667 ML discharge is reported (3,655 ML Category 3 groundwater) - internal inconsistency. Lihir Category 3 seawater discharge volume is unknown and excluded from discharge totals, so Lihir consumption (276,322 = 314,363 - 38,041) effectively counts the seawater as consumed.

Cadia withdrawal excludes storage facility releases (spillway and ecological flow); Cadia is the only site with third-party water (4,876 ML Cat 1) and has the largest reuse (70,455 of 91,904 ML company). Change in storage only reported for Cadia (-480 ML).

Red Chris (acquired Aug 2019) has no environmental data in this file; its data was excluded from assurance scope. Compliance: 0 incidents of non-compliance with discharge limits (GRI index D90), 0 significant spills (D105), 0 significant environmental fines; one non-significant infringement notice at Cadia (FY21) for FY20 dust emissions.

Restatements sheet: FY19 energy intensities restated (self-generated electricity no longer double-counted); no water restatements. FY19 ore processed (66,094,586 t company) and gold-equivalent production (3,071,650 oz) are identical in the restated and previously-published tables.
